Consequence: the in-room-matched LR_SGD is ~22 at the full room (factor ~2.2e4 vs 1e-3) — measured, not assumed. (2) THE SGD-M CORPUS-STEP DIVERGENCE — at that registered lr the FREE unprojected corpus steps (~lr x ||g_corp|| full-L2 each, momentum compounding toward x10) run the model away (smoke: install CE 1.07 -> 98 by s8; |d| -> 78).
